uncertain_points.risk: Exposure of a well-known key that completely undermines confidentiality/integrity of any data protected with it.

security_implications: This package defines security-critical constants (256-bit seeds for key derivation, LFSR seeds/permutations, default hardware key values). The HW_KEY_REQ_DEFAULT and OTBN_KEY_REQ_DEFAULT structs contain a known default key 32'hDEADBEEF; if these default values are used in any active key path without being overwritten, the resulting keys would be completely predictable, exposing all data protected by them. The seed parameters provide the root entropy for the key manager; any ability to read or modify those seeds post-manufacture would allow an attacker to compute all derived secret keys. The local definitions of HealthStateWidth and DevIdWidth risk width mismatches that could corrupt critical identity and health inputs, potentially allowing bypass of security checks or integrity failures.
